title: Button
lead: Enable user interaction with the button component to perform actions on your website as links, for payment, form submission, social buttons and more based on React and Tailwind CSS

prose.text:
The button component is a common UI component found on the web that allows users to trigger certain actions on your website such as submitting a form, navigating to a new page, or downloading a file.

The examples from the Flowbite React library allows you to customise the buttons with different colors, sizes, icons, and more. All examples are built with React and Tailwind CSS.

In order to start using the button component you need to import it from Flowbite React:

prose.title: Default buttons
prose.text: Use this example to create a default button by using the `<Button>` component from React and by adding the `color` property you can change the color of the button.

prose.title: Button pills
prose.text: Add the `pill` property to the `<Button>` component to create a button with rounded corners.

prose.title: Gradient monochrome
prose.text: These beautifully colored buttons built with the gradient color utility classes from Tailwind CSS can be used as a creative alternative to the default button styles.

prose.title: Gradient duotone
prose.text: These buttons use a style that includes two contrasted colors creating an impressive mesh gradient effect.

prose.title: Outline buttons
prose.text: Use the `outline` property to create an outline button with transparent background and colored border.

prose.title: Button sizes
prose.text:
You can update the size of the button by adding the `size` property to the `<Button>` component.

Choose from `xs`, `sm`, `md`, `lg`, and `xl` as the value.

prose.title: Buttons with icon
prose.text: You can add icons to the buttons by adding it inside the `<Button>` component near the text.

prose.title: Button with label
prose.text: This example can be used to show a notification count or helper text inside a button using the [Badge](/docs/components/badge) component.

prose.title: Button with only icons
prose.text: Create a button with only icons by adding the `iconOnly` property to the `<Button>` component. These are useful when you want to show buttons in a small space and for things like pagination.

prose.title: Button with loading state
prose.text: Use the following [Spinner](/docs/components/spinner) component to indicate a loader animation inside buttons:

prose.title: Disabled buttons
prose.text: You can disable the button by adding the `disabled` property to the `<Button>` component.

prose.title: Override Button base component
prose.text: The `as` prop provides you the ability to transform the `<Button />` component into another component or HTML element. This prop accepts a string representing an HTML tag or a functional React component.

prose.title: Theme
prose.text: To learn more about how to customize the appearance of components, please see the [Theme docs](/docs/customize/theme).
